name: _adaptive_avg_pool2d_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_adaptive_avg_pool2d_backward(Tensor grad_output, Tensor self) -> Tensor. The repository artifact ID omits the canonical callable's leading underscore. Computes the input gradient for two-dimensional adaptive average pooling across batched, unbatched, global-pooling and non-square adaptive windows. The result has self's shape and dtype; neither input is mutated or aliased.
